task.goal: Replace the breaker panel in my garage

plan.title: Do not replace garage breaker panel yourself
plan.summary: Breaker panel replacement involves mains electrical and must not be done DIY. Observe safely, document, and hire a licensed electrician.
plan.professionalReason: Replacing a breaker panel involves live mains wiring and the main electrical panel. This work can cause electrocution, fire, and code violations and must be done by a licensed electrician.
plan.sourceNote: AI-written plan · check your owner's manual

steps.title: Observe panel safely from distance
steps.instruction: Stand back and look at the garage breaker panel. Do not touch it or remove the cover. Note any burning smell, buzzing, heat, or scorch marks from a safe distance.

cautions.text: Do not touch breakers, wires, or panel cover. Risk of electrocution even with breakers off.

stopIf: you smell burning or see smoke or sparks
panel is hot buzzing or damaged

steps.title: Read outside labels only
steps.instruction: If the outer door is already closed and safe to view, read the labels on the outside only. Note brand, amperage, and any warning stickers for the electrician.

cautions.text: Keep hands and metal objects away from panel. Do not open door if damaged.

stopIf: door is open with exposed wires

steps.title: Document panel condition
steps.instruction: Take photos of the full panel exterior, any labels, and the surrounding wall area to share with the electrician. Do not remove cover for photos.

cautions.text: Do not operate breakers repeatedly if they are tripping. Leave as is for professional.

check.whatDoneLooksLike: Clear photo shows full panel exterior and labels

steps.title: Leave wiring untouched
steps.instruction: Leave all breakers as they are. Do not switch off main, pull breakers, or unscrew panel. Confirm in your home manual where your main disconnect is located, but do not operate it.

cautions.text: Do not attempt to turn off main or remove breakers yourself. Mains stay live.

steps.title: Prepare notes for electrician
steps.instruction: Write down why you want replacement, panel age, tripping issues, and garage loads. Confirm exact replacement size and type from electrician and permit requirements.

cautions.text: Provide clear information to get correct permit and replacement panel.

steps.title: Call licensed electrician
steps.instruction: Contact a licensed electrician to inspect and replace the garage breaker panel. Share your photos and notes and ask about permits and power shutoff.

cautions.text: Only a licensed electrician should replace the panel and handle utility disconnect.
